status: still wrong (also in v15; not caused by the v15.1 fix)
title: After a sheet, Phase, Landscape, the Deformation or Sphere in landscape, rotating back to portrait leaves no inset: the small plane is drawn full size over the large one
detail: syncPanes() sets .ph-inset only when !(land || ph-split). Anything that calls syncPanes() while the phone is in landscape (closing a sheet, ending Phase or Landscape, the Deformation, the Sphere key, the language reload) removes .ph-inset. The rotation branch of the media-query handler in src/phone.js (the 'else { land = l; ... close(true); A.resize(); reconcile(); }' line, about line 125) does not call syncPanes(), so back in portrait both panes are 390x668 and the non-large plane covers the large one. X is hidden, and the inset's swap button is gone, so the user cannot swap. The next sheet open and close repairs it. The scale does not drift: reconcile() shrinks with the pane's full width, so keep.r is 1, and the later sheet close shrinks properly.
evidence: 390x844 touch, 3z, X large. Rotate to 844x390, Phone.open('display'), Phone.close(), rotate back. paneL and paneR have no .ph-inset, both rects are [0,56,390,668], and Y (u=18.796 at w=376) fills the screen (shot vfy_rot_A.png). It is the same in v15 (notes/v15-candidate/dist/test.html) and in work/xvq/dist/test.html. The same happens after Phase, then a rotation, then X -> Y in landscape, then rotating back. (scratchpad probes c_land.js and c_rot.js)
fix: In the rotation branch, call syncPanes() before A.resize(): 'else { land = l; rootEl.classList.toggle("ph-land", l); close(true); syncPanes(); A.resize(); reconcile(); }'.

status: still wrong (also in v15, and on the desktop; not a phone-swap drift)
title: A reload during the Deformation (autosave and reload, or a language switch) loses Y's own view: Y comes back at its auto fit
detail: This is the part of swap-3 that the fix does not cover. During the Deformation, Y's X -> Y view is parked in defMem.y.v, and writeState saves V.right only when !rightAuto. After the reload Y is auto-fitted, which here is 1.62 times wider than the user's view. X is now right: after 3 rounds, X's view is exact. This does not compound, and the desktop does the same in v15. The language switch in the Deformation also loses Y's view this way, while X and the large plane are kept.
evidence: 3z, user views, Y large. Deformation on, wait 1.2 s, reload, Deformation off, 3 rounds: X 1.1770,1.2485 u=5.2506, exact. Y 4.3268,3.6845 u=11.477 becomes 1.2070,0 u=18.548, then stays there. Desktop 1200x900, v15 and v15.1 the same: Y u=12.651 becomes 20.445. (scratchpad probes c_merged.js reload, c_ydef.js, c_merged.js lang)
fix: Optional, separate from the swap fix: while morph.open, save Y's X -> Y view (defMem.y.v, and rightView null only when defMem.y.auto), so a reload restores it.

title: swap-1 to swap-8 hold in the running app (work/xvq/dist/test.html); the desktop is unchanged
detail: Measured from drawn pixels: the world coordinates at each overlay canvas's left, centre and right edge (s2w), not from the app's view objects. The user's complaint: 40 swaps each for 3z, z/3 and (z-1)/(z+1) show no drift (max/min ratio 1.00000). The large plane comes back exact, and the inset shows the same centre and units per pane width as the plane did large. With the user's own pan and zoom on both planes, 20 more swaps are exact. swap-1: 3 tours with X large and 3 with Y large are exact, then 2 swaps, all exact. Step 'x' shows X at u=7.2308 either way. A reload mid-tour restores both planes exactly. swap-2: leaving the phone layout in Phase, Landscape or the Deformation, 3 round trips to 1200x900 each, are exact. The desktop pixel scale equals the large view's (13.964e-3/px for 5.2506/376). An iPad mini at 744x1133 <-> 1133x744 in Phase, 4 rounds, is exact and Y stays large. swap-3: X is exact over 3 reloads in the Deformation, and the save writes X's large view (s=71.61). swap-4: the first Phase with X the inset gives u=7.2308, the same as with X large, and it keeps the user's view. swap-5: the side-by-side views after a sheet that ends Phase equal a plain sheet's. After a rotation that ends Phase, the pixel scale ratio is 1.0000. swap-6: a language switch in Phase keeps Y large (ru and en, twice each), and X -> Y afterwards is exact. swap-7: with Re z > 0 under 3z and Y auto, Y no longer re-tweens after a swap (x1.000 at 1.2 s, over 6 swaps). Y frames the same image region in the square inset (u=44.99) and large (u=25.87); the difference comes from the aspect ratio and does not compound. swap-8: a swap 80 ms into a Fit ends at the Fit's target (u=6.1828, the same as a Fit alone). 20-round transitions on 3z, z/3 and Möbius, with X large and with Y large (Phase, Landscape, the Deformation, Sphere and Plane, a sheet): 0.0000 % worst, except Y's Sphere -> Plane. That resets Y to its auto fit once and does not compound. It is the same on the desktop and in v15 (it is the app's Plane refit), so it is not reported. Also exact: 20 rotations, and 20 sheets with Y large. Desktop: a sequence of load, pan and zoom, Phase, Landscape, the Deformation, both Fits, a resize and a reload gives byte-identical reads in v15 and v15.1. No console errors.
evidence: Scratchpad probes vlib.js, c_swap.js, c_tour.js, c_leave.js, c_merged.js, c_rest.js, c_sph.js and c_desk.js, run in headless Chrome on port 9014 against work/xvq/dist/test.html and notes/v15-candidate/dist/test.html.
